errors.evidence: The y-axis unit is in Milliarden Euro (billion euros), not Milliarden Mrd. Euro (which would imply trillion euros). This error is repeated throughout the description.
The y-axis range is incorrectly labeled as 200.000 Mrd. Euro instead of 200.000 Millionen Euro or Milliarden Euro.
The tick intervals are incorrectly labeled as 50.000 Mrd. Euro instead of 50.000 Millionen Euro or Milliarden Euro.
The line representing Zufluss is purple, not red.

errors.text_span: erreicht 2020 etwa 27.499 Mrd. Euro und fällt anschließend auf etwa -112.219 Mrd. Euro im Jahr 2021
errors.evidence: The value 27.499 refers to the green bar (Differenz) in 2020, not the Zufluss (purple line). The Zufluss line does not drop to -112.219 in 2021; this value refers to the green bar in 2022.

errors.text_span: beginnt, bis 2006 auf rund 100.000 Mrd. Euro ansteigt
errors.evidence: The Abfluss (blue line) in 2006 is approximately 110.000 Millionen Euro, not 100.000 Mrd. Euro. The unit error is already flagged, but the value is also slightly off.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates financial flows (Finanzströme) between 2005 and 2024, as specified in the atom checklist.
The description does not mention that the green bars are positioned along the horizontal axis below the zero line, except for 2020.
The description does not explicitly state that the green bars are labeled with values in millions of euros above or below each bar.
The description does not mention that the bars are not sorted in any particular order.
The description does not mention the absence of visual highlighting for any specific bar, aside from numerical labels.
The chart title or context specifies 'Mrd. Euro' and financial flows but does not explicitly mention 'Direktinvestitionsströme Deutschlands'. This is an unsupported interpretation.
